source_contracts: Selected grouping keys are already registered by ProcessAggregations; deleting hidden keys from result DISTINCT preserves projection identity.
C12 and C13 must be integrated for non-injective expressions of grouped values; the independent branches address different defects.
Post-aggregate group references now bind to the post-aggregate row.
Only direct group references substitute the physical key at final projection; wrapped expressions retain their computed result alias.
IsExpression returns false only for Member, so the added HeadPtr receiver comparison is reached only on a well-formed Member.
Nested aggregate receivers retain their entire expression and receive a generated input column.
Replacements match only Members of the consuming expression row argument, preserving conditional placement.
Map and Filter implement ApplyReplaceMap; conversion rejects subqueries in Limit, Sort and Join-filter expressions.
Missing correlated count defaults to zero; joined scalar value remains optional.
Arbitrary errors inside scalar subquery projections can still occur before demand; this known limitation is separate from cardinality checking.
The block cross-join special path declines every predicate set containing an unresolved subplan.
Normal classification includes unresolved binding IDs, retaining their predicates above the join until inlining.

unconfirmed_followups.description: Constant selected values combined with grouping and result DISTINCT appear to be materialized before grouping, where the grouped output may no longer expose their generated binding.
references: ProcessAggregations distinctAll branch without group references
unconfirmed_followups.relationship: Pre-existing path outside the C12 hidden-key removal; no regression or additional bug claimed until native reachability is verified.
